releaseNotes:
Medical Store Point of Sale v1.4.4
- Permanent Persistent User Session: Users authenticate once via cloud and remain securely logged in across app restarts, crashes, and Windows reboots using Windows DPAPI.
- Offline POS Continuity: Once authenticated, complete POS operations (billing, sales, customer khata, reports, thermal printing) run 100% uninterrupted offline against local SQLite.
- Online/Offline Reachability Management: Mandatory internet verification for initial Login and Register screens with clear user guidance when disconnected.
- Header Connectivity Badge: Dynamic visual indicator showing real-time Cloud Sync / Offline POS status.
- Secure Manual Logout: Explicit user logout invalidates local DPAPI tokens and cloud session.
- 45 Comprehensive Security & Hardening verification tests passing with 0 failures.
